name: Chrome Prompt API (Gemini Nano)
description: Built-in on-device LLM in Chrome via LanguageModel; shipped in Chrome 148 (May 2026) per secondary reports.

restrictions: Not a library; on-device Gemini Nano model governed by Google terms and Prohibited Use Policy
Mozilla, Apple, Microsoft and the W3C TAG formally opposed; other browsers do not ship it
license.notes: Docs updated 2026-05-19 list Chrome 148; whether core API is stable vs origin trial for sampling params is reported inconsistently.

cost.notes: Needs ~22 GB free disk and >4 GB VRAM or 16 GB RAM; model ~4.27 GB downloaded once (secondary report).

verdictReason: Free, private, but Chrome-desktop-only and heavy; progressive-enhancement tier behind capability check.
